name: Cloak Girl
source:
A mysterious assassin who vows to stop the Apocalypse by any means necessary, she sees the Four Horsewomen as her mortal enemies. Everything about her is shrouded in mystery—but with the Apocalypse approaching, she's certain not to give up so easily.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1071877822/talo-episode-one]Kickstarter[/url]]
